text: Python is a programming language.
Machine learning is a field of artificial intelligence.
Supervised learning uses labeled data for training.
Unsupervised learning discovers patterns in unlabeled data.
Deep learning uses neural networks to model complex relationships.
Reinforcement learning optimizes actions using rewards.
Natural language processing enables computers to understand text.
Computer vision allows machines to interpret images.
Transformers improve sequence modeling in NLP.
Artificial intelligence can classify documents.
Robotics integrates AI with mechanical systems.
Data science combines statistics and computation.
Neural networks consist of multiple layers of computation.
Optimization reduces model loss during training.
Gradient descent updates model parameters iteratively.
Backpropagation computes gradients efficiently.
Classification predicts discrete labels.
Regression predicts continuous values.
Clustering groups similar data points.
Dimensionality reduction compresses high-dimensional data.
AI models require large datasets for training.
Datasets contain samples used for learning.
Features describe the properties of data.
Labels indicate the correct output for supervised learning.
Evaluation measures model performance.
Accuracy measures how often predictions are correct.
Precision measures relevance of predictions.
Recall measures completeness of predictions.
F1 score balances precision and recall.
A confusion matrix summarizes prediction errors.
AI models can overfit when trained too long.
Regularization reduces overfitting.
Dropout improves generalization in neural networks.
Batch normalization stabilizes training.
Learning rate controls the size of parameter updates.
An epoch is one full pass through the dataset.
Mini-batch training splits data into smaller batches.
AI can generate human-like text.
AI can translate languages automatically.
AI can summarize long documents.
AI can detect anomalies in data.
AI can recommend items to users.
AI can rank search results based on relevance.
AI can cluster users based on behavior.
AI can classify images using convolutional networks.
AI can detect objects in photos.
AI can segment images pixel by pixel.
AI can generate realistic images using GANs.
AI can analyze sentiment in text.
AI can extract keywords from documents.
